content.body: I just noticed that we list all editors since ES2015 but not before. We should probably add the early editors to the list.

https://github.com/nicolo-ribaudo/skills/tree/main/review-ecma262-pr This is the LLM skill I mentioned. Depending on what tool you use there are multiple ways to install it and run it; for example with claude code you'd put it as a folder inside `.claude/skills/` and run it as `/review-ecma262-pr <pr number>` or `/review-ecma262-pr review the current branch`
